title: herdr-ticks plugin (si0): paint/notify hooks may now point at ticfac; guard and plugin-install are settled as dropped
body: ticfac tick glb settled the ownership of the five operator surfaces tk dropped: `ticfac factory webhook` (register/--status/--delete), `ticfac herd paint` and `ticfac herd notify` now exist (hooks may be repointed at them; they read ticfac's exec-state attempt records and the run checkpoint, not tk spawn manifests, which no longer exist), while the orchestrator guard and the plugin install/check command are deliberately dropped — the guard's nudge semantics have no meaning for ticfac's program orchestrator (liveness is `ticfac status`, attention is `ticfac watch`), and the plugin is ticks' artifact. Consequence for the plugin: its dashboard/collect/reconcile hooks call commands that no longer exist at all and must be retired, not repointed. The decision record is `ticfac herd --help` and the README's operator-surfaces table in ticfac.
